provenance.selection: All six steps from a smallest nonempty local conversation (95 database files inspected; 32 contain steps). No agent was launched. SQLite sources were opened with mode=ro.
provenance.nativeStorage: SQLite tables with protobuf BLOB columns, not JSON. Native seven-table DDL is preserved. Only trajectory_meta and the selected real steps have INSERTs.
provenance.schemaEvidence: Native .gemini_coder.Step and its retained nested messages were decoded using protobuf descriptors extracted from the installed stripped ELF. protobuf-schema.json includes only fields and enum values actually retained in this sample, not source code or a complete descriptor collection. conversation.decoded.json is an explicitly non-native decoded companion, not invented transcript records.
provenance.historyIndex: No matching prompt-history index entry retained.
provenance.brainSearch: Immediate brain children contained an implementation-plan artifact and its metadata, not a native assistant transcript. Deeper files include tool artifacts and project files; they were not treated as transcripts.

versionEvidence.reason: Installed executable is a stripped ELF with no adjacent package manifest/version file. Its embedded release notes mention 1.5.8, but that alone does not establish the executable or source-session version. No agent/version command was executed.
versionEvidence.descriptorSource: Installed executable protobuf descriptors; no source path, executable hash, or private source hash retained.

currentCapture.versionEvidence: The user identified the authorized synthetic source conversation as agy 1.5.7. No CLI/version command was run.
currentCapture.selection: Only the single user-authorized synthetic SQLite database was opened read-only for this capture. Its trajectory_meta has distinct cascade_id and trajectory_id values and its steps table contains two completed protobuf records.
currentCapture.nativeIdentity: The ACP runtime ID is trajectory_meta.cascade_id. trajectory_meta.trajectory_id identifies the ordered native steps. Discovery reads cascade IDs from database content, independent of the filename. Read requires exactly one row with both IDs present and bounded.
currentCapture.frozenIdentity: Parser version 2 binds both cascade and trajectory into record IDs and the frozen digest. agy3 cursors reject previous cursor formats. An identity remap or frozen-prefix body edit is rejected; later appends remain outside the frozen range.
currentCapture.discovery: Unrelated unsupported databases are isolated. Every readable cascade candidate remains visible even when the trajectory mapping or step format is unsupported, so duplicates still reject runtime selection and a unique unsupported target reaches the reader's format error. Directory, cancellation and limit failures remain errors.
currentCapture.sanitization: Descriptor-known messages were recursively rebuilt using protobuf-schema.json. UUIDs were consistently remapped; all other non-synthetic strings were redacted. The synthetic prompt and ACK retain the project 蓝鹭 and port 48273, with the synthetic marker normalized to WMX-agy-capture. Numeric non-enum metadata was zeroed and timestamps normalized. Unknown fields and opaque bytes were omitted.
currentCapture.coverage: Two completed native steps: user input (14) and planner response (15). The preserved legacy six-step capture separately covers real tool arguments, results and linkage; the 1.5.7 source did not call tools.
currentCapture.limitations: No original database pages, account/configuration records, executor/generator metadata, private reasoning or authentication material are retained. No application-level acceptance or checks were run during capture.

sanitization.freeText: All prompt, response, reasoning, system, tool output, environment, account, path and URL string values are replaced. No original free-text body is retained.
sanitization.identifiers: Global deterministic replacement map shared by trajectory/cascade/execution/message/tool-call IDs and sender/recipient values; UUID-shaped inputs receive fixture UUIDs. No original ID or source-derived hash is retained.
sanitization.tools: The real built-in run_command name and known argument keys are retained. JSON argument values are recursively replaced while retaining JSON scalar/container types. Generic argument strings and tool-result strings are redacted too.
sanitization.binary: Known protobuf messages are rebuilt after recursive schema-guided sanitation. All opaque bytes/signatures and unknown fields/messages are omitted, never copied. SQL hex values are decoded protobuf wire records with accompanying field/type evidence, not unexplained opaque source blobs.
sanitization.timestamps: Timestamp messages are remapped to a fixed synthetic epoch in source ordering, nanos to zero. Prompt-history timestamps are normalized.

coverage.toolLoop: Planner tool_calls -> generic step metadata.tool_call -> generic.result -> later assistant response; the same call ID also appears in the subsequent system agent_message source metadata.

offlineDecoding: Use Python sqlite3.connect(':memory:').executescript(Path('conversation.sql').read_text()) to rebuild only a temporary fixture database. Select steps ORDER BY idx and compare scalar columns with conversation.decoded.json.

For each non-NULL BLOB use protobuf-schema.json.blobColumns to select its message type. Read protobuf varint keys: field_number = key >> 3; wire_type = key & 7. Wire 0 is varint, wire 1 is eight little-endian bytes, wire 2 is varint length followed by that many bytes, and wire 5 is four little-endian bytes.

messages[type][field_number] supplies the original protobuf FieldDescriptorProto type number, field name, referenced typeName and label. Type 9 is UTF-8 string, type 11 recursively decoded message, type 14 numeric enum; the other retained types use their standard protobuf scalar encoding. label 3 appends an array item. A referenced message without a retained field definition is valid only for an empty payload and decodes as {}.

The decoded companion preserves only fields actually present on the wire, uses raw integer values for enums and booleans, and exposes repeated map entries as arrays rather than converting them into objects. Decode all protobuf columns, including duplicated metadata, and compare these objects to the corresponding steps[].<column> values. This requires no installed agy, executable, network service or model.
limitations: This is a six-step excerpt from one real local session, not broad agy version compatibility.
No subagent, fork, image, attachment, encrypted payload, crash recovery, cancellation or large-output coverage is claimed.
Opaque bytes, signatures and fields without a recovered descriptor are intentionally absent; their content is not reconstructed.
The other native SQLite tables retain their DDL only; generator/executor/trajectory metadata and parent/battle records are outside this excerpt.
The decoded JSON companion and field-schema evidence are inspection aids, not a claim that agy writes JSON transcripts.
Application-level acceptance of re-encoded sanitized protobuf has not been tested, and no checks or agent execution were run.
